title: Novel synthesis of 2,6‐benzothiazonine derivatives
abstract: AbstractThe reaction of 1‐alkylamino‐1‐alkylthio‐3‐phenyl‐3‐thioxopropenes with phthaloyl chloride in toluene at 60°C, followed by treatment with triethylamine, afforded 6‐alkyl‐3‐phenyl‐2,6‐benzothiazonine‐1,5,7‐triones in good to excellent yields.
